name: @magic-modal/demo-video
description: Remotion source for the README demo video, GIF and poster in media/

scripts.render:all: pnpm run render:gif && pnpm run render:poster
scripts.render:gif: pnpm run render:intermediate && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/intermediate.mp4 -filter_complex "scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[s0][s1];[s0]palettegen[p];[s1][p]paletteuse" -r 12 -t 15 ../../media/magic-modal-demo.gif
